content_sections.heading: NISER Scientific Administrative Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NISER Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NISER Scientific Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NISER Scientific Administrative Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Scientific Administrative Assistant posts at NISER is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate Degree in Any Discipline with a minimum of 80% marks or a CGPA of 8.5 or above to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position is 50 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at NISER.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the NISER Scientific Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the National Institute of Science Education and Research (NISER) in Bhubaneswar, Odisha (PIN: 752050).

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Scientific Administrative Assistant position is a contractual job as per the official notification.
